verses.original: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵי־ כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־ יְמִינִֽי׃ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי חָסִ֑יתִי בְּךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃ מִכָּל־ רֹ֝דְפַ֗י
verses.transliteration: šig·gā·yō·wn lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·šer- šār Yah·weh ‘al- diḇ·rê- ḵūš ben- yə·mî·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay ḥā·sî·ṯî bə·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mik·kāl rō·ḏə·p̄ay
verses.literal: A Shiggaion of David which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush vvv a Benjamite O LORD my God I take refuge in You save me and deliver me from all my pursuers

verses.original: פֶּן־ יִטְרֹ֣ף נַפְשִׁ֑י כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yiṭ·rōp̄ nap̄·šî kə·’ar·yêh pō·rêq wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־ עָ֥וֶל יֶשׁ־ בְּכַפָּֽי׃
verses.literal: O LORD my God if I have done this if injustice is on my hands

verses.original: אִם־ גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- gā·mal·tî šō·wl·mî rā‘ wā·’ă·ḥal·lə·ṣāh ṣō·wr·rî rê·qām
verses.literal: if I have rewarded my ally with evil if I have plundered my foe without cause

verses.original: אוֹיֵ֨ב׀ יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיִרְמֹ֣ס חַיָּ֑י לָאָ֣רֶץ יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן וּכְבוֹדִ֓י׀ לֶעָפָ֖ר סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·yêḇ yi·rad·dōp̄ wə·yaś·śêḡ nap̄·šî wə·yir·mōs ḥay·yāy lā·’ā·reṣ yaš·kên ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî le·‘ā·p̄ār se·lāh
verses.literal: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust Selah

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י צִוִּֽיתָ׃ מִשְׁפָּ֥ט
verses.transliteration: qū·māh Yah·weh bə·’ap·pe·ḵā hin·nā·śê bə·‘aḇ·rō·wṯ ṣō·wr·rāy wə·‘ū·rāh ’ê·lay ṣiw·wî·ṯā miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Arise O LORD in Your anger rise up against the fury of my enemies Awake my God and ordain judgment

verses.original: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ שֽׁוּבָה׃ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḏaṯ lə·’um·mîm tə·sō·wḇ·ḇe·kā šū·ḇāh wə·‘ā·le·hā lam·mā·rō·wm
verses.literal: Let the assembled peoples gather around You take Your seat over them on high

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm šā·p̄ə·ṭê·nî Yah·weh kə·ṣiḏ·qî ū·ḵə·ṯum·mî ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: The LORD judges the peoples vindicate me O LORD according to my righteousness and integrity . . .

verses.original: יִגְמָר־ רַ֨ע׀ רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק נָ֬א צַדִּֽיק׃ אֱלֹהִ֥ים וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·mār- ra‘ rə·šā·‘îm ū·ṯə·ḵō·w·nên ṣad·dîq nā ṣad·dîq ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇō·ḥên lib·bō·wṯ ū·ḵə·lā·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Put an end to the evil of the wicked but establish the righteous O righteous God who searches hearts and minds

verses.original: מָֽגִנִּ֥י עַל־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.literal: My shield is with God who saves the upright in heart

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים צַדִּ֑יק שׁוֹפֵ֣ט וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־ יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣad·dîq šō·w·p̄êṭ wə·’êl zō·‘êm bə·ḵāl yō·wm
verses.literal: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב יִלְט֑וֹשׁ חַרְבּ֣וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō yā·šūḇ yil·ṭō·wōš ḥar·bōw ḏā·raḵ way·ḵō·wn·ne·hā qaš·tōw
verses.literal: If one does not repent God will sharpen His sword He has bent and strung His bow

verses.original: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין מָ֑וֶת כְּלֵי־ יִפְעָֽל׃ חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: wə·lōw hê·ḵîn mā·weṯ kə·lê- yip̄·‘āl ḥiṣ·ṣāw lə·ḏō·lə·qîm
verses.literal: He has prepared His deadly weapons He ordains His arrows with fire

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־ אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.literal: Behold [the wicked man] travails with evil he conceives trouble and births falsehood

verses.original: כָּ֭רָֽה בּ֣וֹר וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kā·rāh bō·wr way·yaḥ·pə·rê·hū way·yip·pōl bə·ša·ḥaṯ yip̄·‘āl
verses.literal: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out he has fallen into a pit of his own making

verses.original: עֲמָל֣וֹ יָשׁ֣וּב בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·mā·lōw yā·šūḇ ḇə·rō·šōw ḥă·mā·sōw yê·rêḏ wə·‘al qā·ḏə·qo·ḏōw
verses.literal: His trouble recoils on himself and his violence falls on his own head

verses.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High
